plan: Queue jungle as primary. It is Xeebs's best role at 52.3% over 315 games (overall is 50.1%). Set midlane as secondary, not the other way around.
Stop queueing carry: 42.7% over 192 games is costing real VP. When auto-filled there, play the safest comfort pick, not a learning pick.
Comfort-hero rule for the climb: Khaimera. Compared with the average player on the same hero, Xeebs wins about 4.7 more games per 100 on it.
Xeebs's champion pool is 11+ heroes wide and the top three are only 40% of the games. Gold-to-Platinum climbs are almost always pool-narrowing stories: aim for 70%+ of games on the top three.
Park Drongo, Serath for ranked: 37% over 51; 38% over 50. Keep them for normals.
The math: Xeebs is at 299 VP; Platinum III starts at 900. The all-time peak is 692.
honesty: personal winrates are shrunk toward the player's own average (small heater samples do not count as mains)
field baselines are all-ranks aggregates from our current-patch match sample, not Gold-bracket-specific yet
winrate edges are observational; they say where the player wins, not why

insights.title: Xeebs is a closer, not a marathoner
insights.finding: Games under 28 minutes: 60%. Past 32: 44%. Press early leads and call objectives; do not let games drift.
insights.receipt: wins 6 of 10 short games vs 4 of 9 long ones, recent sample

insights.title: Vision is Xeebs's cheapest upgrade
insights.finding: 4.7 wards per game, 56% of the squad average. Wards cost nothing and they are being left in the shop.
insights.receipt: 4,323 placed + 269 cleared over 969 games; squad average 8.5/game

insights.title: Khaimera is the long-term relationship
insights.finding: 172 games and Xeebs genuinely out-pilots the field on Khaimera — about 4.7 more wins per 100 games than the average Khaimera player. The hours show.

insights.title: Mr_Meat31 brings out Xeebs's best
insights.finding: Xeebs's record alongside Mr_Meat31 is 54% over 284 ranked games — the strongest pairing in the stack. When only two of the squad queue, make it this pair.

insights.title: For the group chat
insights.finding: A longest killing spree of 21 in real 5v5s (plus 3 more in ARAM and brawls — the group chat can rule on whether those count). Xeebs has receipts.
